purpose: Blender raycasting LiDAR simulation for realistic time-series deformation testing with occlusion, density gradient, and intensity.
method: scene.ray_cast() from 3 scanner positions per epoch, spherical grid 0.5deg resolution
units: meters; deformation values in ground_truth.csv are millimeters

registration.note: Each epoch Tn (n>=1) point cloud is stored in its own scanner frame, simulating an unknown TLS setup pose. registration_transforms.json maps T0->epoch; apply its inverse to align an epoch back to T0. Use the 3 target spheres (label 5) for target-based registration, then verify recovered transform against ground truth. This dataset now exercises Step 3 Auto-align end-to-end, not just deformation analysis.

scanner.positions_note: Scanners sit on the curved centerline at arc-length (chainage) 10/40/70 m, tripod height z=-1.3 m (~1.5 m above the track bed). X/Y follow the alignment, so they are NOT on a straight Y axis.

tunnel.geometry: circular ARCH above the floor (NOT a full ring); lining spans crown down to the springline at floor level z=-2.8 m. Below the floor there is no lining (invert/fill), matching a real tunnel scanned from ground up.
tunnel.scale_source: real dimensions measured from sample_pcd/circle_tunnel_dw.las (local PCA circle fit: bore radius ~4.25 m)
tunnel.alignment: gentle horizontal curve, radius 500 m, turning toward +X; end lateral offset 6.39 m at arc-length 80 m
tunnel.chainage_definition: arc length along the curved centerline (0..80 m)
tunnel.surface_undulation_m: baked as-built waviness ~1.0-1.5 cm RMS (low-freq sin + 5 mm random), constant across epochs (NOT scan noise)

scene_objects.note: Built in a clean metric scene at real scale; detail set (rails/sleepers/cable trays/lights/targets) styled after the reference Blender model. All fixtures follow the curved alignment. People are scale references (label 9), filterable as non-structure.

features: Real-scale circular TBM rail tunnel (8.5 m bore, sized from circle_tunnel_dw.las)
Curved horizontal alignment (R=500 m) - realistic, not a straight cylinder
Full rail track: 2 rails (1.435 m gauge), sleepers, ballast bed, side walkways
Both-wall LED lighting system + cable trays / conduits / handrails (styled after reference model)
3 human figures as scale reference (label 9, filterable as non-structure)
Baked as-built surface undulation (~1.5 cm) so the lining is not perfectly smooth
Raycasting-based occlusion (real shadow zones behind track, fixtures, people)
Distance-dependent point density (near scanner = dense, far = sparse)
Per-epoch rigid mis-registration to exercise Step 3 Auto-align
3 registration target spheres at known positions
deformation_note: Deformation chainages (20/45/65 m) are measured as arc length along the curved centerline. Crown/sidewall directions are defined in the local cross-section frame (rotated with the curve).
